pr.title: Fix search treating % and _ as wildcards

lenses.note: A bug fix. The change does what the PR says: it escapes %, _ and \ and adds ESCAPE '\'. Nothing extra was added.
No spec file in this change; the PR's words are the intent.

New tests insert titles containing %, _ and \ and assert exact matches. They would fail against the old unescaped LIKE. No tests were deleted or loosened. I could not run them because vitest is not installed here, so I checked them by reading.
README only says ?q= searches titles. Nothing in it is stale.
The escape regex /[\\%_]/g with the \\$& replacement matches the ESCAPE '\\' clause in the SQL. The escaped value is still bound as a parameter, so it is not interpolated into the SQL.
The search value stays a bound parameter. The change adds no injection risk and plants no instructions.
The diff touches no UI files; src/index.js changes only the query.
The diff touches no UI files.
The title is under 72 characters. The claims about the ESCAPE clause, the escaped characters, the new test and 'tests deleted: none' all match the diff.
